description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git check-ignore' functionality. It contains test definitions, setup procedures, and various test cases to validate ignore rules, submodules, symlinks, global exclude files, whitespace handling, and streaming support for the command.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes global variables related to ignore rules configuration.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Sets up global exclude files by configuring git with the global excludes file.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Stores expected output to a specified destination, either stdout or stderr.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Wrapper to store expected stdout output.

methods.name: expect_from_stdin
methods.description: Stores expected input for stdin-based tests.

methods.name: test_stderr
methods.description: Checks whether the stderr output contains a specified pattern.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Verifies if the stderr output contains the given regex pattern.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Checks if stderr is empty or contains expected content based on the exit code.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Main function to run the check-ignore command with given arguments and verify its output and exit status.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified setup and verification.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multi
methods.description: Runs multiple success tests with different verbosity and options.

methods.name: test_expect_success_no_index_multi
methods.description: Runs multiple tests ignoring the index.
